scope: Offline research protocol/specification and development fixtures only
dynamic_constraints: assessments object properties exactly expected IDs; required all; additionalProperties false
assessment values retain existing fields except item_id omitted; raw key supplies identity
host_checks: input IDs unique globally, nonempty, no reserved coverage ID,1<=N<=1000
response IDs exactly schedule and unique
all source evidence resolves without clipping/repair
unknown relation/channel/modality never promoted to preserved/complete
global_coverage_location: existing top-level completeness and missing_items; reason explicitly evaluates record.coverage claim; no assessment row named coverage
source_first_oracle: Independent source-unit universe and frozen artifact assessment, not derived from record IDs, provider coverage, or verifier missing_items
selected_response_design: exact-ID keyed assessment object; minimal lossless wire-only adaptation
strict_parse_policy: Reject duplicate member keys at every depth before construction of dict/object; reject nonstandard NaN/Infinity and malformed/trailing JSON. Never last-key-wins.
normalization: After strict parse and wire validation only, iterate expected sorted IDs, add item_id from each key, preserve all assessment values/global fields exactly, change only schema_version to round7.record_verdict.v1; then existing host validation. No dropping/repair.
audit_truth_limit: Local reviewed artifact and hashes establish recorded review and binding, not semantic truth or authenticated authority.
wire_ref_validation: Explicit bounded known-local expansion before existing schema validation; no unresolved refs, remote lookup or ignored keywords.
